race.description: Ladbrokes Tote Win +10% In October Plate (C1)
race.comment: MONOTONE (5) made a complete mess of his rivals at the Sunshine Coast in his stable debut and looks above average. Can keep the ball rolling with Thompson sticking. BOTANIST (2) returns a gelding in his first start for the Dunn camp and shoulders solid NSW form that reads well for this. Fitted with two trials and gets in well with Newman's 3kg claim. QUICKZOU (6) is the proven local danger and is ready to hit his straps third-up after being collared late last start. Has enough dash to offset the wide draw and should give a bold sight. Ex-Kiwi AMOURETTE (10) is an interesting runner making her stable debut for the the Lakey team. Got off the mark on debut back in April at Ellerslie and her two trials in readiness suggests she's come on well during the break. Can play a big role in her Aussie debut.
